verdict.rationale: Teller is API-first for its core data: balances, transactions with pagination, identity, account details, and payments with idempotency are all documented as API resources, and a community user reports the API is easy to script against. Parity with the UI is incomplete, though: webhooks are configured from the Teller Dashboard, and account linking runs through the Teller Connect UI component. Missing for 10: API-based management of dashboard functions such as webhook registration, evidence of programmatic app/certificate administration, and a published machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
